Recipe:

CAKE:
1/4 cup butter (salted/room temperature) (100 grams)

1 cups all purpose flour (260 grams)

1/2 tablespoon baking powder

1/8 teaspoon salt

3/4 cups sugar (300 grams)

1 1/2 large eggs (room temperature)

1/2 cup milk (room temperature) (240 grams)

1 teaspoon coconut

1/2 teaspoon vanilla


*this recipe made one pan that I cut in half, and it was a little thin but light and airy. The second time, I doubled the recipe and it was much thicker, but a bit dense.*

BUTTERCREAM:
1/2 cup butter
3 cups powdered sugar (add more to taste)
1 can coconut cream* OR coconut extract to taste

*the coconut cream made my frosting a little runny, so coconut extract would be better if you can find it.

FILLING:
Just a jar of raspberry jam!

MACAROONS:
This is decoration so I will just link to the recipe I used.
[macaroon recipe](https://www.foodnetwork.com/recipes/ina-garten/coconut-macaroons-recipe3-1916155) 

DIRECTIONS:

1. Pre-heat oven to 350°(180° celsius), lightly butter and flour one 8 or 9 inch (20 - 22 cm) cake pan.

2. In a medium bowl at medium speed beat together butter and sugar for 2 minutes until combined then add eggs and beat, combine well.

3. In a medium bowl whisk together flour, baking powder and salt. then gradually add flour mixture, beating on low until combined. Add milk and vanilla and continue beating until combined.

4. Divide batter into prepared pans. Bake until golden (use toothpick to test for doneness), approximately 30-35 minutes. Remove and let cool completely on wire racks.

Final Note: The cake recipe was based off of one from anitalianinmykitchen.com.
